tbesh_html:
1) to seek, search out, spy out, explore
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to seek out, select, find out how to do something
1a2) to spy out, explore
1a2a) explorers, spies (participle)
1a3) to go about
1a3a) merchant, trader (participle)
1b) (Hiphil) to make a search, make a reconnaissance

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to meander (causatively, guide) about, especially fortrade or reconnoitring
strongs_1890.kjv_def: chap(-man), sent to descry, be excellent, merchant(-man), search (out), seek, (e-) spy (out).
